title: Filesystem MCP Server
summary: Give an agent scoped file access through the reference Filesystem MCP server, limited to the folders you list and optionally read-only.
description: The Filesystem server is part of the official Model Context Protocol servers repository. It reads, searches and edits files, but only inside the directories you pass on the command line.
Use it with agents that have no file tools of their own, or to expose a notes or docs folder outside the project. This config passes the current folder and starts in read-only mode.
useWhen: Let a chat client read a notes or docs folder
Expose one folder to an agent and nothing else
Search many text files by name or content
Keep access read-only while the agent explores

mcp.name: filesystem
access: Reads files inside the listed folders only

example.prompt: Find every markdown file under docs that mentions "rate limit" and list the headings that contain it.
example.result: 3 files: docs/api.md ("Rate limits"), docs/errors.md ("429 and rate limit headers"), docs/faq.md ("Why was my request limited?").

faq.question: How do I allow more folders?
faq.answer: Add each path as another argument after the package name. The server refuses anything outside them.

faq.question: How do I let it write?
faq.answer: Remove the --read-only flag. Check the folder list first, since writes are real.

access: Reads files in the listed folders only
